breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains both 'Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift' AND 'Keep the k-point grid gamma-centered', which are contradictory instructions. The ground truth removes the gamma-centered constraint entirely, keeping only the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid. The agent repeated the original error by including both conflicting instructions.
